title: エリートトレーナーとの出会い

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, when we're training for the URA Finale…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I run into Aoi Kiryuin, one of my colleagues and an excellent trainer, along with her trainee, Happy Meek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Watching the two clumsily develop their bond, I renew my commitment to my own trainee.
